name: etracker-mcp
description: Query the etracker Analytics Report API from Claude (read-only).
long_description: Read-only access to the etracker Analytics Report API: list reports, inspect their metadata, fetch report rows for a date range, and compare two periods. Connects to a hosted etracker MCP server; you provide your own etracker access token (scope: Reporting API).

url.title: Server URL
url.description: Endpoint of the etracker MCP server. Leave the default unless you run your own instance.

token.title: etracker Access Token
token.description: etracker access token with scope "Reporting API" (Settings → Account → Integration).
